homeStory.subtitle: Our DNA
homeStory.title: From Odense to the Metaverse
homeStory.p1: At Innopixel, we operate under the philosophy that digital experiences of the future must feel tangible, valuable, and handcrafted down to every single pixel.
homeStory.p2: With deep roots in the Funen innovation ecosystem, we build XR solutions that bridge complex technology and meaningful human interaction.

homeCta.title: Ready to build something unique together?
homeCta.description: Whether you need an immersive VR simulator, an AR app, or an interactive 3D dashboard, we are ready to advise.

servicesPage.bannerDesc: We design and craft digital pixel solutions tailored to your organization's educational or commercial needs. From immersive simulations to playful 3D elements.
servicesPage.edutechDesc: Pedagogical technology built with gamification principles. We transform dry educational material into engaging, tactile learning games.
servicesPage.consultingDesc: From initial idea to executed strategy. We help companies and institutions clarify XR feasibility, hardware choices, and implementation.
servicesPage.step1Desc: Clarifying goals, target audiences, and tech stack.
servicesPage.step2Desc: Wireframes, 3D sketches, and quick interactive prototypes.
servicesPage.step3Desc: Unity/WebGL coding, 3D modeling, and spatial sound design.
servicesPage.step4Desc: Field user testing, optimization, and final deployment.

storyPage.bannerDesc: From a vision to unite digital craftsmanship with enterprise value, to a fully established production hub in the heart of Odense.
storyPage.pHandcraft1: Innopixel was founded with a desire to challenge generic digital templates. We believe every 3D model, line of code, and user interaction deserves meticulous craftsmanship.
storyPage.pHandcraft2: Over the past decade, we have developed solutions ranging from AR harbor applications for school children to HoloLens industrial repair guides for offshore wind turbines.
storyPage.pPhilosophy: Technology should never be a gimmick. For us, XR is a medium to convey complex knowledge, spark emotion, and optimize work processes.
storyPage.pStudio: Located in Odense's vibrant robotics and tech hub, we collaborate closely with local educational institutions, museums, and innovative companies across Denmark.

homeStory.subtitle: Vores DNA
homeStory.title: Fra Odense til Metaverset
homeStory.p1: Hos Innopixel arbejder vi ud fra en filosofi om, at fremtidens digitale oplevelser skal føles nærværende, værdifulde og håndlavede ned til den enkelte pixel.
homeStory.p2: Med dybe rødder i det fynske innovationsmiljø skaber vi XR-løsninger, der bygger bro mellem kompleks teknologi og meningsfuld menneskelig interaktion.

homeCta.title: Klar til at skabe noget unikt sammen?

storyPage.bannerDesc: Fra en vision om at forene digitalt håndværk med erhvervsmæssig værdi, til en fuldt etableret produktions-hub i hjertet af Odense.
storyPage.pHandcraft1: Innopixel blev stiftet ud fra et ønske om at udfordre generiske digitale skabeloner. Vi tror på, at enhver 3D-model, linje kode og brugerinteraktion fortjener omhyggeligt håndværk.
storyPage.pHandcraft2: Gennem de seneste 10 år har vi udviklet alt fra AR-havneapplikationer til skolebørn til HoloLens-industrielle reparationsguides til havvindmøller.
storyPage.pPhilosophy: Teknologi bør aldrig være en gimmick. For os er XR et medie til at formidle kompleks viden, vække følelser og optimere arbejdsgange.
storyPage.pStudio: Placeret i Odenses stærke robot- og teknologimiljø arbejder vi tæt sammen med lokale uddannelsesinstitutioner, museer og innovative virksomheder i hele Danmark.
